4875-5411-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-1832-2034-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-5933.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4054-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4054-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1429-3545-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

2034-2073-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2034-2073-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-6006-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1303-3249-3967-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1660-7779.description:
Cast Natural Affinity by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands to become 2/2 creatures in addition to their other types.
Cast Ezuri's Predation by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 4/4 Phyrexian Beast for each creature and land your opponents control, and then causing a Phyrexian Beast to fight each of those creatures and lands.
Each land opponents control will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, as will each creature opponents control that had toughness 4 or less.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4496-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1530-7538.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
You control two creatures that can attack without being killed.
1530-7538.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, sacrificing itself and causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
In your combat phase, declare any two creatures as attackers.
When you attack, Eiganjo Dynastorian triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Replenish from exile by paying {3}{W}, returning Second Chance and any other enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each extra turn.

5742-5743-6753-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
2292-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

813-5733-7174.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-5733-7174.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

413-3090-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1836-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control three lands that are mana-producing and share a name.
539-1836-4657.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, adding at least {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the land and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

372-961-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Against All Odds.
372-961-2974.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Against All Odds.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.

3492-3609-3963-4112.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block Meneldor.
3492-3609-3963-4112.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

777-1020-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2397-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1912-2757-5685.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
1912-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {1}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1339-2292-3284.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2292-3284.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

876-2703-4659-4772.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator tokens.

224-539-1003-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-1003-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

1887-2290-4158-4772-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder have at least one +1/+1 counter.
Your life total is at least four.
1887-2290-4158-4772-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Compleation's third ability by tapping it and paying three life, causing you to put four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilitieis.
Activate Staff of Compleation's last ability by paying {5}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and life, you may activate Staff of Compleation's other abilities.

176-2292-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-2292-4875.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2781-3908-4768.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}.
Spark Double enters the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Spark Double's trigger, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian's trigger, blinking Spark Double.
Repeat from step 2.
